review_description: I had a pleasant experience with Vortex. Simon was very easy to talk to and gave great advice. I had done my homework so knew the different panels and inverters. Their price wasn't the cheapest, nor was it  on the high end, but the expertise in the installation was totally worth it. The team of guys were polite and helpful with info if asked and the site was cleaned on completion. No mess left. Would recommend highly.

The quoting & sales was smooth sailing with Simon & he made things easy to understand & we went with his recommendation of a 18 panel 8.4kw system with a Fronius Primo 8kw inverter. The install went smoothly without a hitch with a team that were courteous and thorough with their workmanship. Once the install was complete I was guided through the web portal plus they organise the grid connect. The best part of going with Vortex is that not only are they good with solar but they are electricians as well and you can't beat a tradie with all round knowledge!

The 3 quotes were very similar, even in price although Vortex ended up being the best price by far. (They received the panels at a lower price than they'd quoted and actually passed that saving on to me!) Also the fact it was a Geelong company held a lot of sway with me.  I like to shop local.All 3 salesmen were excellent at their job although admittedly one of them did maybe over-sell it a bit. (That salesperson had been suggesting my TV aerial would need to be moved and the inverter would need to go out by the switchboard (out in the weather) and they were two things Vortex and the 2nd salesman hadn't suggested. Plus someone from that company rang me later to match the offer that I was taking up, I'd already signed the contract. So they were very keen.The installation went without a hitch, the guys were great. All in all I was very impressed with Vortex and I now just wait to see my next power bill!
From first contact to completed installation communication was excellent. Quality of installation is first class with every detail finished professionally.
Gave me heads up when there was a delayGood installation.

Simon from Vortex Electricals, Geelong has been very transparent about communicatng the pros and cons of various battery systems. He suggested Sigenergy battery system with a Gateway to be installed as AC coupled with the existing 6KW GOODWE inverter and 8KW Solar system. I think it is one of the best systems around now, and the price of the 13.5KWH battery system was reasonable. I was happy to secure the Interest free battery loan($8800) in around 3 weeks and the installation got completed just over a week after. The installation team did a great job and Chantler from the installation team answered all my queries in regards to the functions and operations of using the new system. The installer organised the Electrical inspector on the day after installation and the battery unit was turned on after inspection. There has been no electricity bills after installation and excess power is also being exported into the grid, and I am also considering to join a VPP. The product features, ease of using Sigen app and the aesthetic appeal of the device is really worth the money invested. After sales support has been excellent so far and I am very thankful to Solar quotes in suggesting Vortex Electrical, Geelong for completing my Solar battery project.

Simon from Vortex phoned to discuss my requirements, but then arranged to visit the property the next day to take a look at the roof, electrics etc and discuss where the inverter would be placed.  His was the only company to do a site visit before quoting.Installation was quick, smooth, fuss-free.  The team were polite and friendly.  They showed me how to set up my iPad with the inverter app, which was really helpful.The quote came in at well below the other two installers; one was double the Vortex quote.Simon was communicative throughout the process.I am extremely happy with Vortex and wont hesitate to use them again for future projects.

Representatives from the three installation companies recommended by Solar Quotes contacted us promptly.   Their salespersons were polite, friendly and most importantly, knowledgeable!We ended up with three detailed quotes, two of which were for an identical system.   One was SIGNIFICANTLY cheaper.The VORTEX installation team were punctual, friendly, considerate and efficient.   We were impressed with their workmanship.   Our old system was removed and the new panels, inverter and battery installed over three days (progress was slowed by particularly windy weather).The inspector who turned on our new system reassured us that Vortex Electrical’s installations are always “first rate”.Since installation, we’ve had another site visit where our questions about the battery’s operation have been answered and we’ve gained more information regarding maximising our “energy savings”.We are VERY pleased with our new solar system!Since it was turned on nine days ago, 100% of the energy we have used in our home has been generated by the system
Honest and genuine follow-up.Good service and friendly team.Competitive pricing.
Quoting process was great Simon came out and went through the quote for the system

We obtained four quotes - three from Solar Quotes and one independent.  All but one quoted on recommended, proven hardware. Simon from Vortex did what he said he would do, when he said he would. He was considerate in his design/placement for the battery and other components and his team was neat and professional when doing the work. I was impressed with the extra effort he took in working out where things could go before he got the job.

Sophie and her team of workers were great in the quoting process: reliable, informative and helpful.The installation was excellent: they were punctual, efficient and cleaned up after themselves.We have just had the system installed so it will late a few weeks to get is all signed off and working.They were the only company who understood our overall aim of electrification and provided a one stop shop for a big solar system, inverter, installation of new induction cooktop, supply and install of new hot water system and heat pump and a complex job of retrofitting our heating and cooling system, as well as some other minor electrical works. They organised all the trades and extra works (plasterer, painter, carpenter). This made the whole process and project, although expensive, worth the price, because it was a one stop shop, and so efficient. We are now gas free, have electrified everything and will be providing almost all of our energy needs self sufficiently, with the possibility of installing a battery later.

The only sales person that came to see us in person before quoting, thus ensuring there would be no surprise additions on installation day or post quote. The salesperson Sophie responded to my initial request for quotes through solar quotes very quickly, even though it was the start of the year and everyone was still gradually returning back to work. She also responded to many questions we had post quote as we wanted to ensure we were future proofing for EVs.Installation day was a breeze. The crew arrived a bit later than communicated which caused a little bit of stress, but they arrived just before school drop off so I was still home.The crew was very considerate. They played a bit of fetch with our dog in the backyard and gave me plenty of notice regarding power outages as I was working from home.Highly recommend. They didn't try to sell us something we didn't need and responded very quickly.

I had a great experience with Vortex Electrical. Quoting process was quick and easy with Sophie. Simon and the guys were great to deal with for the installation. The time from quote approval to install was reasonable. Maddie was always quick to respond to all of my questions via email. It's still early days but our power bill has at least halved since having solar installed.

Sophie's customer service was outstanding - she made sure she visited and analysed the property (the only company who did), asked me plenty of questions to make sure she understood our needs and aims for the system, and had it all installed within a month of signing the contract.Still awaiting the inspector so we can use the system, but Sophie has already been in contact to organise to come and talk us through the monitoring app. Brilliant.
